# Why [Quarto]{.alert}? {background-color="#2F4647"}


## Why [Quarto]{.alert} {#ecosystem-slide}

:::: {#ecosystem-diagram .ecosystem-animated}
```{mermaid}
%%| fig-width: 14
flowchart LR
    classDef input fill:#F2F7F6,stroke:#7CA6A0,stroke-width:1px,color:#2F4647;
    classDef core fill:#2F4647,stroke:#2F4647,stroke-width:2px,color:#FFFFFF,font-weight:bold;
    classDef engine fill:#FCEBDD,stroke:#D97838,stroke-width:2px,color:#87421D,font-weight:bold;
    classDef output fill:#E4F0ED,stroke:#4F8C82,stroke-width:1px,color:#2F4647;
    classDef history fill:#FFFFFF,stroke:#D97838,stroke-width:1px, color:#87421D;
    linkStyle default stroke:#7A9290,stroke-width:1.5px;

    C["fa:fa-code Analysis"]:::input
    T["fa:fa-file-alt Text"]:::input
    R["fa:fa-book References"]:::input

    MD["fa:fa-file-alt Markdown"]:::history
    LANG["fa:fa-code Python / R / Julia"]:::history
    BIB["fa:fa-book BibTeX / Zotero"]:::history
    QMD["fa:fa-file-code Quarto document<br/>(.qmd)"]:::core

    Y["fa:fa-sliders-h YAML<br/>Settings & metadata"]:::history
    PD["fa:fa-exchange-alt Pandoc<br/>Document conversion"]:::history
    G["fa:fa-code-branch Git<br/>History & collaboration"]:::history
    Q["fa:fa-cogs Quarto<br/>Computation + publishing"]:::engine

    W["fa:fa-file-word Word<br/>Document"]:::output
    P["fa:fa-file-pdf PDF<br/>Document"]:::output
    Web["fa:fa-globe HTML<br/>Website"]:::output
    S["fa:fa-chalkboard Slides<br/>Presentation"]:::output

    %% First click: the source document and its ingredients.
    T --> MD
    C --> LANG
    R --> BIB
    MD --> QMD
    LANG --> QMD
    BIB --> QMD

    %% Second click: computation, settings, conversion and publishing.
    QMD ==> Q
    Y --> Q
    PD --> Q
    G -.- QMD
    Q ==> W
    Q ==> P
    Q ==> Web
    Q ==> S

    class MD,LANG,BIB,QMD step1;
    class Y,PD,G,Q step2;
```
::::

::: {.notes}

Pandoc = Engine

:::


## Markdown {.tool-introduction}

::: {.tool-summary}
- [What?]{.alert} Lightweight markup for headings, lists, links and emphasis.  
- [Why?]{.alert} Keep the source readable and focus on content and structure.
:::

<iframe src="https://quarto.org/docs/authoring/markdown-basics.html" title="Quarto Markdown Basics" width="100%" height="450" style="border:0;"></iframe>

::: {.tool-source}
[Open Quarto Markdown Basics ↗](https://quarto.org/docs/authoring/markdown-basics.html)
:::

## Pandoc {.tool-introduction}

::: {.tool-summary}
- [What?]{.alert} Converts documents between formats such as Markdown, HTML and Word.  
- [Why?]{.alert} One source, many outputs: the conversion machinery inside Quarto.
:::

<iframe src="https://pandoc.org" title="Pandoc document converter" width="100%" height="450" style="border:0;"></iframe>

::: {.tool-source}
[Open the Pandoc website ↗](https://pandoc.org)
:::

## YAML {.tool-introduction}

::: {.tool-summary}
- [What?]{.alert} A readable data format built from keys, values and indentation.  
- [Why?]{.alert} In Quarto: declare the document's metadata and publishing settings.
:::

<iframe src="https://yaml.org/about/" title="About YAML" width="100%" height="450" style="border:0;"></iframe>

::: {.tool-source}
[Open the YAML website ↗](https://yaml.org/about/)
:::

## Git {.tool-introduction}

::: {.tool-summary}
- [What?]{.alert} A distributed version control system that records changes to files.  
- [Why?]{.alert} Keep a history, compare versions, and collaborate on shared work.
:::

<iframe src="https://git-scm.com" title="Git version control" width="100%" height="450" style="border:0;"></iframe>

::: {.tool-source}
[Open the Git website ↗](https://git-scm.com)
:::

## What is Quarto {.definition-fragments}

<span style="font-size: 0.5em;"></span>

::: {.nonincremental}

- **Open-source scientific and technical [publishing system]{.alert}**
  - Leverages modern tools for content and structure ([Markdown]{.alert}) and configuration ([YAML]{.alert})


:::

::: {.fragment .nonincremental}

- **Favours [reproducibility]{.alert} and [transparency]{.alert}**
  - Supports [executable code]{.alert} within text

<span style="font-size: 0.5em;"></span>

:::

::: {.fragment .nonincremental}

- **Supports [multiple output formats]{.alert}**
  - [Pandoc]{.alert} is the conversion machinery underneath!

<span style="font-size: 0.5em;"></span>

:::

::: {.fragment .nonincremental}

- **Successor to R Markdown but [language-agnostic]{.alert}**
  - *Python*, *R*, *Julia*, ...

<span style="font-size: 0.5em;"></span>

:::

::: {.fragment .nonincremental}

- **Integration in most IDE**
  - *VS Code*, *RStudio*, *Jupyter*...

<span style="font-size: 0.5em;"></span>

:::

::: {.notes}

“You update an analysis. Now you need to replace a figure, change a number in the text, update the slides, and check the references. What if these pieces stayed connected?”

- friction between writing, running analysis, producing figures and tables and formatting citations
- how to favour reproducibility and transparency?
- instead, one document for text, 
:::

# Quarto for [research]{.alert}  {background-color="#2F4647"}

## A first document from scratch


<!-- BEGIN COL -->
:::: {.columns} 
::: {.column width="48%"}

- **One document** containing:
  - [Text]{.alert} (→ *Markdown*)
  - [Code]{.alert} (→ *Python*)
  - [Configuration]{.alert} (*→ YAML*)
- **One output** → [HTML]{.alert}
- Good strategy for **basic workflows**

`quarto preview test_doc.md`
`quarto render test_doc.md`



:::
::: {.column width="4%"}
:::
::: {.column width="48%"}

<span style="font-size: 0.5em;">&nbsp;</span>


::: {style="width:100%; display:flex; justify-content:center; text-align: center"}

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
    %% Orange / teal theme
    classDef input fill:#F2F7F6,stroke:#7CA6A0,color:#2F4647;
    classDef source fill:#2F4647,stroke:#2F4647,color:#FFFFFF,font-weight:bold;
    classDef engine fill:#FCEBDD,stroke:#D97838,stroke-width:2px,color:#87421D,font-weight:bold;
    classDef output fill:#E4F0ED,stroke:#4F8C82,color:#2F4647;
    linkStyle default stroke:#7A9290,stroke-width:1.5px;

    DATA["fa:fa-table Data"]:::input
    BIB["fa:fa-book references.bib"]:::input
    YAML["fa:fa-sliders-h _quarto.yml"]:::input

    DOC["fa:fa-file-alt manuscript.qmd<br/>Text + Python"]:::source
    Q["fa:fa-cogs Quarto + Pandoc"]:::engine
    PDF["fa:fa-file-pdf manuscript.pdf"]:::output
```

## One analysis, several documents {.example-workflow}

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
    %% Orange / teal theme
    classDef input fill:#F2F7F6,stroke:#7CA6A0,color:#2F4647;
    classDef source fill:#2F4647,stroke:#2F4647,color:#FFFFFF,font-weight:bold;
    classDef engine fill:#FCEBDD,stroke:#D97838,stroke-width:2px,color:#87421D,font-weight:bold;
    classDef output fill:#E4F0ED,stroke:#4F8C82,color:#2F4647;
    linkStyle default stroke:#7A9290,stroke-width:1.5px;

    %% Shared inputs
    DATA["fa:fa-table Data"]:::input
    PY["fa:fa-code analysis.py"]:::input

    BIB["fa:fa-book references.bib"]:::input
    YAML["fa:fa-sliders-h _quarto.yml"]:::input

    %% Three document sources
    SL["fa:fa-chalkboard slides.qmd"]:::source
    DOC["fa:fa-file-alt manuscript.qmd"]:::source
    WEB["fa:fa-globe webpage.qmd"]:::source

    %% Rendering engine
    Q["fa:fa-cogs Quarto + Pandoc"]:::engine

    %% Outputs
    REVEAL["fa:fa-chalkboard slides.html"]:::output
    PDF["fa:fa-file-pdf manuscript.pdf"]:::output
    WORD["fa:fa-file-word manuscript.docx"]:::output
    HTML["fa:fa-globe webpage.html"]:::output

    DATA --> PY

    PY --> SL
    PY --> DOC
    PY --> WEB

    BIB --> YAML
    YAML --> Q

    SL --> Q
    DOC --> Q
    WEB --> Q

    Q --> REVEAL
    Q --> PDF
    Q --> WORD
    Q --> HTML
```
